description_en: You can invoke ListIntervalSkillGroupReport to obtain the segment-based statistical report of a specified skill group under a specified instance
description_zh: 调用ListIntervalSkillGroupReport获取指定实例下指定技能组的分段统计报表
kebab_example: aliyun ccc list-interval-skill-group-report --skill-group-id skg-default@ccc-test --instance-id ccc-test --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListIntervalSkillGroupReport

parameters.help_en: Start Time, formatted as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. This parameter is optional. The default value is 00:00 of the current day. Statistics are aggregated by hour, rounded down to the nearest hour, and the interval is closed
parameters.help_zh: 开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位毫秒，非必填，默认为当天的0时，统计的时间精度为小时，向前取整，闭区间
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: End Time, formatted as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. This parameter is optional. The default value is the current time. If Interval is Daily, the maximum interval between StartTime and EndTime is 180 days. If Interval is Hourly, the maximum interval is 10 days. The time precision for statistics is hourly, snapped backward to the nearest hour, using an open interval. For example, if the Start Time is 11:12:20 and the End Time is 11:45:50, the aligned input parameter Time Range becomes [11:00:00, 12:00:00), meaning greater than or equal to 11:00:00 and less than 12:00:00
parameters.help_zh: 截止时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位毫秒，非必填，默认是当前时间，如果Interval为Daily，StartTime和EndTime最大间隔是180天。如果Interval为Hourly，最大间隔时间为10天。统计的时间精度为小时，向后取整，开区间。例如：开始时间为11:12:20，结束时间为11:45:50，则对齐后的入参时间范围为[11:00:00,12:00:00) ，即大于等于11点，小于12点
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: Segment statistics type. The default is Daily (aggregated by day)
parameters.help_zh: 分段统计类型，默认为Daily（按天汇总）
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en: Media type. The default is Audio. Other valid values include Chat and Video
parameters.help_zh: 媒体类型，默认是语音(Audio), 其他可选参数包括Chat和Video
parameters.name: media_type

Data.description_en: List of segment-based statistics for the skill group
Data.description_zh: 技能组分段统计数据列表

items.description_en: Segment-based statistics for the skill group

AnswerRate.description_en: Answer rate. Calculation Formula: CallsAnswered / CallsDialed. (Because management events for answering and acknowledgement may fall into different Time Ranges, the Result may exceed 100% in certain cases.)
AnswerRate.description_zh: 接通率，计算公式为：CallsAnswered/CallsDialed（由于接听事件与应答事件可能落在不同的时间范围内，所以某些情况下结果可能大于100%）

AverageCustomerRingTime.description_en: Average ring time on the Customer side, in seconds
AverageCustomerRingTime.description_zh: 平均客户侧振铃时长，单位秒

CallsAgentHandled.description_en: Quantity of calls handled by agents

CallsCustomerAnswered.description_en: Quantity of calls answered by the Customer

MaxCustomerRingTime.description_en: Maximum customer-side ring time, in seconds
MaxCustomerRingTime.description_zh: 最大客户侧振铃时长，单位秒

TotalCustomerRingTime.description_en: Total customer-side ring time, in seconds
TotalCustomerRingTime.description_zh: 总客户侧振岭时长，单位秒

AbandonRate.description_en: Abandon rate. Calculation Formula: CallsAbandoned / CallsOffered (because management events related to abandonment and assignment may fall into different time ranges, the result may exceed 100% in certain cases)
AbandonRate.description_zh: 放弃率。计算公式为：CallsAbandoned/CallsOffered（由于放弃事件与分配事件可能落在不同的时间范围内，所以某些情况下结果可能大于100%）

AverageAbandonTime.description_en: Average abandonment duration, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalAbandonTime / CallsAbandoned
AverageAbandonTime.description_zh: 平均放弃时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalAbandonTime/CallsAbandoned

AverageAbandonedInQueueTime.description_en: Average abandoned-in-queue duration, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalAbandonedInQueueTime / CallsAbandonedInQueue
AverageAbandonedInQueueTime.description_zh: 平均排队放弃时长，单位秒。计算公式为： TotalAbandonedInQueueTime/CallsAbandonedInQueue

AverageAbandonedInRingTime.description_en: Average ringing abandonment duration, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalAbandonedInRingTime / CallsAbandonedInRing
AverageAbandonedInRingTime.description_zh: 平均振铃放弃时长，单位秒。计算公式为： TotalAbandonedInRingTime/CallsAbandonedInRing

AverageFirstResponseTime.description_en: Average first response time for chat sessions, in seconds
AverageFirstResponseTime.description_zh: Chat会话平均首次响应时长，单位为秒

AverageHoldTime.description_en: Average hold time during calls, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalHoldTime / CallsHold
AverageHoldTime.description_zh: 平均通话保持时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalHoldTime/CallsHold

AverageResponseTime.description_en: Average response time for chat sessions

AverageRingTime.description_en: Average ring time, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalRingTime / CallsRinged
AverageRingTime.description_zh: 平均振铃时长，单位秒。计算公式为： TotalRingTime/CallsRinged

AverageTalkTime.description_en: Average talk duration, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalTalkTime / CallsHandled
AverageTalkTime.description_zh: 平均通话时长，单位秒。计算公式为： TotalTalkTime/CallsHandled

AverageWaitTime.description_en: Average wait time, which is the average duration a caller waits before an agent answers the call. Calculation Formula: TotalWaitTime / CallsHandled
AverageWaitTime.description_zh: 平均等待时长，平均每通电话的坐席接起前等待时长。计算公式为：TotalWaitTime/CallsHandled

AverageWorkTime.description_en: Average post-processing duration, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalWorkTime / CallsHandled
AverageWorkTime.description_zh: 平均话后处理时长，单位秒。计算公式为： TotalWorkTime/CallsHandled

CallsAbandoned.description_en: Abandoned call quantity. Calculation Formula: CallsAbandonedInQueue + CallsAbandonedInRing

CallsAbandonedInQueue.description_en: Quantity of abandoned calls in queue, which refers to the number of calls where the customer hung up after entering the queue but before being answered
CallsAbandonedInQueue.description_zh: 队列放弃量，即电话进入队列之后在排队环节客户挂机的数量

CallsAbandonedInRing.description_en: Ring abandonment count, which refers to the number of calls abandoned by customers while ringing to an agent
CallsAbandonedInRing.description_zh: 振铃放弃量，即坐席振铃中客户挂机的数量

CallsAttendedTransferIn.description_en: Attended transfer-in count, which is the number of calls transferred to this skill group via attended transfers initiated from other skill groups. Transfers between agents within the same skill group are not counted. If an agent signs in to multiple skill groups simultaneously, the call is attributed to the first skill group the agent signed in to. If a single call is transferred from another skill group to this skill group multiple times, each transfer is counted separately. The same rule applies below
CallsAttendedTransferIn.description_zh: 咨询转入量，即由其他技能组发起的咨询转接到该技能组的电话数量，同一技能组内坐席间的转接不计数。若一个坐席同时迁入多个技能组，则该电话的统计归属于签入的第一个技能组。若一通电话由其他技能组多次转接到该技能组，每次转接算一次。下同

CallsAttendedTransferOut.description_en: Attended transfer-out count, which refers to the number of calls transferred from this skill group to another skill group for consultation. Transfers between agents within the same skill group are not counted
CallsAttendedTransferOut.description_zh: 咨询转出量，即由该技能组发起的咨询转接到其他技能组的电话数量，同一技能组内坐席间的转接不计数

CallsBlindTransferIn.description_en: Quantity of blind transfer-in calls, which refers to the number of calls directly transferred into this skill group from other skill groups. Transfers between agents within the same skill group are not counted. If an agent is signed into multiple skill groups simultaneously, the call is attributed to the first skill group the agent signed into. If a single call is transferred multiple times from other skill groups into this skill group, each transfer is counted separately. The same rule applies below
CallsBlindTransferIn.description_zh: 直接转入量，即由其他技能组发起的直接转接到该技能组的电话数量，同一技能组内坐席间的转接不计数。若一个坐席同时签入多个技能组，则该电话的统计归属于签入的第一个技能组。若一通电话由其他技能组多次转接到该技能组，每次转接算一次。下同

CallsBlindTransferOut.description_en: Quantity of blind transfer-out calls, which refers to the number of calls directly transferred out from this skill group to other skill groups. Transfers between agents within the same skill group are not counted
CallsBlindTransferOut.description_zh: 直接转出量，即由该技能组发起的直接转接到其他技能组的电话数量，同一技能组内坐席间的转接不计数

CallsHandled.description_en: Acknowledgement count, which is the number of times agents answered calls. For a single call that enters a queue multiple times, if it is answered by multiple agents after one queue entry, it is counted as one
CallsHandled.description_zh: 应答量，即坐席应答的次数。一通电话每次进入队列后，若被多个坐席应答，算一次

CallsHold.description_en: Hold count, which is the number of times calls were placed on hold. If a single call enters the queue and is placed on hold multiple times, it is counted as one
CallsHold.description_zh: 保持量，即发生通话保持的次数。一通电话每次进入队列后，若发生多次通话保持，算一次

CallsOffered.description_en: Assigned call volume, which is the number of calls assigned to this skill group, including calls assigned through queues and calls assigned via transfers (consultation transfers and direct transfers). Calculation formula: CallsQueued + CallsBlindTransferIn + CallsAttendedTransferIn
CallsOffered.description_zh: 分配量，即分配给该技能组的电话数量，包括通过队列分配的电话数量和通过转接（咨询转接和直接转接）分配的电话数量。计算公式为：CallsQueued+CallsBlindTransferIn+CallsAttentandedTransferIn

CallsOverflow.description_en: Overflow count, which is the number of calls that overflowed from a queue (skill group). If a single call enters the same queue multiple times, each overflow is counted separately
CallsOverflow.description_zh: 溢出量，即发生队列（技能组）溢出的电话数量。若一通电话多次进入同一队列，每次溢出算一次

CallsQueued.description_en: Number of inbound calls entering a queue (skill group). If a single call enters the same queue multiple times, each entry is counted separately
CallsQueued.description_zh: 呼入场景进入队列（技能组）的电话数量，若一通电话多次进入同一队列，每次进入算一次

CallsQueuingOverflow.description_en: Number of calls that overflowed from the queue, meaning calls that experienced queue overflow while waiting in the IVR queue
CallsQueuingOverflow.description_zh: 队列溢出的通话数量，即通话在IVR排队时队列溢出

CallsQueuingTimeout.description_en: Number of calls that timed out during the queuing phase
CallsQueuingTimeout.description_zh: 在排队阶段超时的通话数量

CallsRinged.description_en: Number of calls that rang to agents. Each time a call enters the queue and is assigned to multiple agents, resulting in ringing, it is counted as one occurrence
CallsRinged.description_zh: 坐席振铃的电话数量，一通电话每次进入队列后，若分配给多个座席并产生了振铃，算一次

CallsTimeout.description_en: Timeout count, which is the number of calls that timed out in a queue (skill group). If a single call enters the same queue multiple times, each timeout is counted separately
CallsTimeout.description_zh: 超时量，即发生队列（技能组）超时的电话数量。若一通电话多次进入同一队列，每次超时算一次

HandleRate.description_en: Acknowledgement rate. Calculation Formula: CallsHandled / CallsOffered (because acknowledgement events and assignment events may fall into different time ranges, the result may exceed 100% in certain cases)
HandleRate.description_zh: 应答率。计算公式为：CallsHandled/CallsOffered（由于应答事件与分配事件可能落在不同的时间范围内，所以某些情况下结果可能大于100%）

MaxAbandonedInQueueTime.description_en: Maximum queue abandonment duration, in seconds
MaxAbandonedInQueueTime.description_zh: 最大排队放弃时长，单位秒

MaxAbandonedInRingTime.description_en: Maximum ring abandonment duration, in seconds
MaxAbandonedInRingTime.description_zh: 最大振铃放弃时长，单位秒

MaxHoldTime.description_zh: 最大通话保持时长，单位秒

MaxWorkTime.description_zh: 最大话后处理时长，单位秒

SatisfactionIndex.description_en: Satisfaction index, which is the average value of the satisfaction rating digits (single-digit numbers) entered by callers
SatisfactionIndex.description_zh: 满意度指数，即满意度按键数字（1位数字）的平均值

SatisfactionRate.description_en: Satisfaction rate. Calculation Formula: Number of evaluations marked as satisfied divided by the count of satisfaction survey responses
SatisfactionRate.description_zh: 满意率，计算公式为：标记为满意的评价数/满意度调查响应次数

ServiceLevel20.description_en: Service level within 20 seconds: the number of calls with waiting time less than or equal to 20 seconds divided by CallsQueued
ServiceLevel20.description_zh: 20秒服务水平，等待时长小于等于20秒的电话数量/CallsQueued

TotalAbandonedInQueueTime.description_en: Total queue abandonment duration, in seconds
TotalAbandonedInQueueTime.description_zh: 总排队放弃时长，单位秒

TotalAbandonedInRingTime.description_en: Total ringing abandonment duration, in seconds
TotalAbandonedInRingTime.description_zh: 总振铃放弃时长，单位秒

TotalHoldTime.description_en: Total call hold time, in seconds
TotalHoldTime.description_zh: 总通话保持时长，单位秒

TotalMessagesSent.description_en: Total number of messages sent in chat sessions

TotalMessagesSentByAgent.description_en: Total number of messages sent by agents in chat sessions
TotalMessagesSentByAgent.description_zh: Chat会话中坐席发送的总消息量

TotalMessagesSentByCustomer.description_en: Total number of messages sent by the Customer in chat sessions
TotalMessagesSentByCustomer.description_zh: Chat会话中客户发送的总消息量

TotalWorkTime.description_zh: 总话后处理时长，单位秒

AnswerRate.description_en: Answer rate. Calculation Formula: CallsAnswered / CallsDialed (because management events for answering and acknowledgement may fall into different Time Ranges, the Result may exceed 100% in certain cases)
AnswerRate.description_zh: 接通率，计算公式为：CallsAnswered/CallsDialed（由于接听事件与应答事件可能落在不同的时间范围内，所以某些情况下结果可能大于100%）

AverageDialingTime.description_en: Average dial-up duration, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalDialingTime / CallsDialed
AverageDialingTime.description_zh: 平均拨号时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalDialingTime/CallsDialed

AverageHoldTime.description_en: Average hold time during calls, in seconds. Calculation formula: TotalHoldTime / CallsHold
AverageHoldTime.description_zh: 平均通话保持时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalHoldTime/CallsHold

AverageRingTime.description_en: Average ring time in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalRingTime / CallsRinged
AverageRingTime.description_zh: 平均振铃时长，单位秒。计算公式为： TotalRingTime/CallsRinged

AverageTalkTime.description_en: Average talk time, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalTalkTime / CallsAnswered
AverageTalkTime.description_zh: 平均通话时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalTalkTime/CallsAnswered

AverageWorkTime.description_en: Average post-processing time in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalWorkTime / CallsDialed
AverageWorkTime.description_zh: 平均话后处理时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalWorkTime/CallsDialed

CallsAttendedTransferIn.description_en: Transfer-in calls, which refer to the number of calls transferred to this skill group from other skill groups. Transfers between agents within the same skill group are not counted. If an agent is signed into multiple skill groups simultaneously, the call is attributed to the first skill group the agent signed into. If a single call is transferred multiple times from other skill groups to this skill group, each transfer is counted separately. The same rule applies below
CallsAttendedTransferIn.description_zh: 咨询转入量，即由其他技能组发起的咨询转接到该技能组的电话数量，同一技能组内坐席间的转接不计数。若一个坐席同时迁入多个技能组，则该电话的统计归属于签入的第一个技能组。若一通电话由其他技能组多次转接到该技能组，每次转接算一次。下同

CallsAttendedTransferOut.description_en: Transfer-out call volume, which refers to the number of calls initiated by this skill group and transferred to other skill groups. Transfers between agents within the same skill group are not counted
CallsAttendedTransferOut.description_zh: 咨询转出量，即由该技能组发起的咨询转接到其他技能组的电话数量，同一技能组内坐席间的转接不计数

CallsBlindTransferIn.description_en: Direct transfer-in calls, which refer to the number of calls directly transferred to this skill group from other skill groups. Transfers between agents within the same skill group are not counted. If an agent is signed into multiple skill groups simultaneously, the call is attributed to the first skill group the agent signed into. If a single call is transferred multiple times from other skill groups to this skill group, each transfer is counted separately. The same rule applies below
CallsBlindTransferIn.description_zh: 直接转入量，即由其他技能组发起的直接转接到该技能组的电话数量，同一技能组内坐席间的转接不计数。若一个坐席同时签入多个技能组，则该电话的统计归属于签入的第一个技能组。若一通电话由其他技能组多次转接到该技能组，每次转接算一次。下同

CallsBlindTransferOut.description_en: Direct transfer-out calls, which refer to the number of calls directly transferred from this skill group to other skill groups. Transfers between agents within the same skill group are not counted
CallsBlindTransferOut.description_zh: 直接转出量，即由该技能组发起的直接转接到其他技能组的电话数量，同一技能组内坐席间的转接不计数

CallsHold.description_en: Hold count, which is the number of calls that were placed on hold. If a single call was placed on hold multiple times before being transferred out of the current skill group, it is counted as one
CallsHold.description_zh: 保持量，即发生通话保持的电话数量。一通电话在转出当前技能组之前，若发生多次通话保持，算一次

CallsRinged.description_en: Number of calls that rang to agents. Each call is counted once per queue entry, even if it was assigned to multiple agents and rang multiple times
CallsRinged.description_zh: 坐席振铃的电话数量，一通电话每次进入队列后，若分配给多个座席并产生了振铃，算一次

MaxHoldTime.description_en: Maximum hold time during a call, in seconds
MaxHoldTime.description_zh: 最大通话保持时长，单位秒

MaxWorkTime.description_zh: 最大话后处理时长，单位秒

SatisfactionIndex.description_en: Satisfaction index, which is the average value of the satisfaction key digits (single-digit numbers)
SatisfactionIndex.description_zh: 满意度指数，即满意度按键数字（1位数字）的平均值

SatisfactionRate.description_en: Satisfaction rate. Calculation Formula: number of evaluations marked as satisfied / Count of satisfaction survey responses
SatisfactionRate.description_zh: 满意率，计算公式为：标记为满意的评价数/满意度调查响应次数

TotalHoldTime.description_en: Total hold time during calls, in seconds
TotalHoldTime.description_zh: 总通话保持时长，单位秒

TotalWorkTime.description_zh: 总话后处理时长，单位秒

AverageBreakTime.description_en: Average break time, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalBreakTime / Count of breaks. The Count of breaks is not a field provided by the API
AverageBreakTime.description_zh: 平均小休时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalBreakTime/小休次数。小休次数为非接口统计字段

AverageHoldTime.description_en: Average call hold time, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalHoldTime / (Inbound CallsHold + Outbound CallsHold)
AverageHoldTime.description_zh: 平均通话保持时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalHoldTime/(呼入CallsHold+呼出CallsHold)

AverageReadyTime.description_en: Average ready time, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalReadyTime / Count of ready events. The count of ready events is not an API statistical field
AverageReadyTime.description_zh: 平均就绪时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalReadyTime/就绪次数。就绪次数为非接口统计字段

AverageTalkTime.description_en: Average talk time, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalTalkTime / (CallsAnswered + CallsHandled)
AverageTalkTime.description_zh: 平均通话时长，单位秒。计算公式为： TotalTalkTime/(CallsAnswered+CallsHandled)

AverageWorkTime.description_en: Average post-processing time, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalWorkTime / TotalCalls
AverageWorkTime.description_zh: 平均话后处理时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalWorkTime/TotalCalls

Count.description_en: Number of occurrences of this break type
Count.description_zh: 此类型小休的发生次数

Duration.description_en: Total duration of this break type, in seconds
Duration.description_zh: 此类型小休的总计发生时长，单位为秒

MaxHoldTime.description_en: Maximum call hold duration, in seconds
MaxHoldTime.description_zh: 最大通话保持时长，单位秒

MaxWorkTime.description_zh: 最大话后处理时长，单位秒

OccupancyRate.description_en: Agent occupancy rate, calculated using the formula: (TotalWorkTime + TotalTalkTime) / TotalLoggedInTime
OccupancyRate.description_zh: 座席利用率，计算公式为： (TotalworkTime + TotalTalkTime ) / TotalLoggedInTime

SatisfactionIndex.description_en: Satisfaction index, which is the average value of the single-digit satisfaction rating entered by users
SatisfactionIndex.description_zh: 满意度指数，即满意度按键数字（1位数字）的平均值

SatisfactionRate.description_en: Satisfaction rate. Calculation Formula: Number of evaluations marked as satisfied / Count of satisfaction survey responses
SatisfactionRate.description_zh: 满意率，计算公式为：标记为满意的评价数/满意度调查响应次数

TotalCalls.description_en: Total call volume. Calculation Formula: CallsOffered + CallsDialed
TotalCalls.description_zh: 总电话量。计算公式为：CallsOffered + CallsDialed

TotalWorkTime.description_zh: 总话后处理时长，单位秒

StatsTime.description_en: Start Time of the time segment, formatted as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
StatsTime.description_zh: 时间段的开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位毫秒
